independent_classical_seed_statistics.scope: Between-seed dispersion only; does not include finite-bead, integration, coordinate or shared systematic bias.

prior_incomplete_attempt.provenance: fresh endpoint-to-rate trajectories before recording-interval adjustment
prior_incomplete_attempt.reason: MBAR raw reduced-potential matrix alone is approximately 222 streams x 2.22e6 observations x 8 bytes = 3.94 GB, plus solver work arrays. Memory exhaustion is the likely cause; no rate estimate exists.
prior_incomplete_attempt.action: Retain raw checkpoints and restart same physical trajectory protocol with recording interval10fs (previously0.5fs) and12bootstrapdraws(previously40).

full.effective_samples_note: Scalar CV autocorrelation only; production FES uses maximum linear/amplitude-CV correlation and may report fewer effective samples.

thin20.effective_samples_note: Scalar CV autocorrelation only; production FES uses maximum linear/amplitude-CV correlation and may report fewer effective samples.

prior_incomplete_attempt.diagnostic_scope: QTST only from the completed fresh dense trajectory checkpoints; no recrossing or total rate was computed for this aborted analysis.

conventions.channels: two equivalent product arrangements in coordinate; no extra factor of two

protocol_differences_from_paper: Andersen thermostat instead of Table 1 GLE; this study uses Cayley, and an identical propagator is not claimed
Independent endpoint search supplies the TS; paper supplied a saddle geometry
Far shorter equilibration and sampling; paper uses 200 trajectories per window, 20 ps equilibration and 100 ps production each
Four independent constrained-parent chains and 512 children of 100 fs; paper reports 100000 children of 50 fs
Numerical PMF quadrature uses 1001 grid points instead of the Table 1 5000
Twelve PMF bootstrap draws give only rough within-run uncertainty; independent-seed and replica/time-half variation are also reported

uncertainty_interpretation.interval_scope: Percentile intervals involving the PMF use only 12 bootstrap draws and are low-draw diagnostics, not established coverage guarantees.
uncertainty_interpretation.recording_scope: Changing the recording interval keeps the integrated trajectories and physical thermostat schedule unchanged but changes the finite-sample estimator; dense-versus-thinned diagnostics are retained separately when available.
uncertainty_interpretation.primary_checks: independent-seed dispersion, separate umbrella replicas, temporal halves and timestep sensitivity

rate_uncertainty.conditional_quantity: recrossing uncertainty with the QTST factor held fixed
rate_uncertainty.combination: independent draws from the PMF and constrained-parent block bootstrap distributions, with the selected dividing surface fixed
rate_uncertainty.independence_assumption: Constrained-parent burn-in removes correlation with the umbrella endpoint used to initialize it; this is not established automatically.

warnings: Bootstrap uncertainty has limited block support: some streams have fewer than 20 blocks or the requested 5*g length was capped at half the stream. The reported error is a finite-sample diagnostic, not a reliable interval.
Unsampled/insufficient-count bins are masked; no extrapolation is reported.
Some supported bins lack complete bootstrap support; their main standard errors are unavailable. supported_draw_standard_error describes surviving draws only and is a conditional diagnostic.
Gaussian UI models each biased window by its mean and variance; inspect non-Gaussian window distributions or compare with MBAR.

Complete rate uncertainty has limited support: pmf_bootstrap_limited_blocks. Recrossing-only conditional uncertainty holds QTST fixed; supported-draw uncertainty is conditional on complete PMF support.

support.model: Gaussian-window integration within the umbrella-center range

results.convergence_note: A detected time plateau is not bead, timestep, Rinf or statistical convergence.

interpretation: These are fresh endpoint-to-rate runs. Historical archived pilots, if discussed elsewhere, are separate evidence.
Ratios compare identical temperature, PES and channel conventions. P=1 compares only to the classical row; P=128 compares only to the RPMD row.
A plateau or a favorable rate ratio alone is not a convergence result.
The target-implied barrier is derived with the calculated reactant prefactor, not a separately tabulated paper value.

scheduling.concurrency: Quantum and remaining classical studies ran in separate output trees and separate evidence reports, then these completed case records were combined.
scheduling.boundary_stop: After classical-B completed, the original two-worker invocation stopped at the existing-output guard before classical-C. No classical-C trajectory from that invocation is included.

source_provenance_note: Production preparation, rate and analysis code stayed fixed during these calculations. The benchmark harness received metadata/aggregation-only edits while the earlier two-worker invocation was running; the four-worker invocations used frozen scientific code and settings. The final CLI error-exit/duplicate-case guards are reporting safeguards and do not change the numerical protocol. Per-case settings, runtime manifests, source hashes and artifact hashes are retained. The dense initial attempt used a different recording interval and bootstrap count, as explicitly recorded, and is not pooled as an independent seed.
bibliographic_corrections: An early harness note described the paper propagator as Verlet without a verified primary-source statement. This unsupported claim was removed; the verified Table 1 thermostat is GLE, and this study uses Andersen/Cayley.

uncertainty_interpretation.within_run: PMF uncertainty uses only 12 bootstrap draws and limited correlation blocks; rate percentile intervals are low-draw diagnostics, not demonstrated confidence coverage.
uncertainty_interpretation.between_seed: The independent-seed standard error uses distinct full classical runs only; the same-seed half-timestep case and dense reanalysis are excluded.
uncertainty_interpretation.physical_scope: Neither classical sampling convergence nor quantum bead/time-step/sampling convergence is established. All physical-validation flags remain false or null.

classical_timestep_sensitivity.scope: Full endpoint-to-rate reruns with the same root seed, physical equilibration/production lengths and thermostat collision interval; not an additional independent seed.
classical_timestep_sensitivity.interpretation: The timestep change is small for this case; independent-seed and umbrella-replica sampling variation is much larger. This does not establish all numerical or physical convergence criteria.

source_audit.harness_difference_scope: Primary-rate/status metadata, runtime labeling, verified propagator wording and CLI duplicate/error safeguards only; the scientific protocol is unchanged.

completed_work_totals.scope: Accepted five-case studies only; aborted/rejected attempts and controlled quantum child replay are separate.
